text: I’d rather be able to say “she’s cute” about a woman at the next table, and have my girlfriend say the same about some guy, without it turning into a fight, because if only the serious crushes ever get mentioned, every crush you do mention feels like a confession, and people start hiding them all.
reader: Someone in, or weighing, a monogamous relationship.
